glossary.role: Class of insect-like Byston Well mecha fielded by the Drake Army and Show's side.
Aura battleship of Queen Ciela Lapana (Kingdom of Na)
Anti-Orphan battleship (carrier with a pyramid superstructure); base of the Brain Powerd pilots
The type of Antibody that rebels against Orphan; generic Brain Powerd unit (also the series title)
Evolved Antibody created by reviving a Grand Cher (e.g. Jonathan Baronz, Quincy Baronz).
The people who serve Orphan and pilot Grand Chers to gather its plates; plural 'Reclaimers'
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers
Dotless form of バロン・ズゥ: Jonathan's/Quincy's powerful Antibody (also 巨大バロンズゥ).
Main antagonist; Lord of House Luft in the Kingdom of Ah (アの国), who summons Holy Warriors and wages war to unite Byston Well; commands the Will Wipps
glossary.personality: Ambitious, scheming warlord who believes his conquest is justified. Loves his daughter Riml but is blind to the plots around him.

glossary.role: Masked figure who seizes control of Orphan in Jonathan's name and gives him the Baronz; secretly Anoa McCormick, the missing captain of Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Mysterious, theatrical and manipulative. Acts as a mentor to Jonathan, driven by a twisted longing for her estranged son.

glossary.role: Female lead; 17-year-old Brain Powerd pilot (Hime Brain) aboard the Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Cheerful, warm and motherly toward the children and her Brain. Optimistic and brave, and believes in talking to people and Antibodies alike.

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of op25_04. Covers Phase 3 mission conclusion with Novis Noah reaching Orphan, Drake's opportunistic betrayal to seize Orphan, Baron Maximilian's declaration, the battle against Quincy Isser in her red Baron Zu, Hime speaking to Orphan with personal affection and confronting Quincy, and Irene Carrier's tactical briefing as Hime and Yuu prepare to persuade Orphan.
